entities.summary: Ahmad al-Tifashi whose full name is Shihab al-Din Abu al-Abbās Aḥmad ibn Yusuf al-Ḳaysi al-Tifachi, born in Tifash, a village near Gafsa in Ifriqiya was an Arabic poet, writer, and anthologist, best known for his work A Promenade of the Hearts.
